activateTokens(uint256).details: Deposit tokens in order to have chances of being drawn. Note that once tokens are deposited,  there is no possibility of depositing more.

params._value: Amount of tokens (in basic units) to deposit.

amountJurors(uint256).details: Return the amount of jurors which are or will be drawn in the dispute. The number of jurors is doubled and 1 is added at each appeal. We have proven the formula by recurrence. This avoid having a variable number of jurors which would be updated in order to save gas.

params._disputeID: The ID of the dispute we compute the amount of jurors.

amountJurors(uint256).return: nbJurors The number of jurors which are drawn.

appeal(uint256,bytes).details: Appeal a ruling. Note that it has to be called before the arbitrator contract calls rule.

params._disputeID: ID of the dispute to be appealed.
params._extraData: Standard but not used by this contract.

appealCost(uint256,bytes).details: Compute the cost of appeal. It is recommended not to increase it often,  as it can be highly time and gas consuming for the arbitrated contracts to cope with fee augmentation.

params._disputeID: ID of the dispute to be appealed.

arbitrationCost(bytes).details: Compute the cost of arbitration. It is recommended not to increase it often,  as it can be highly time and gas consuming for the arbitrated contracts to cope with fee augmentation.

params._extraData: Null for the default number. Other first 16 bits will be used to return the number of jurors.

createDispute(uint256,bytes).details: Create a dispute. Must be called by the arbitrable contract. Must be paid at least arbitrationCost().

params._choices: Amount of choices the arbitrator can make in this dispute.
params._extraData: Null for the default number. Otherwise, first 16 bytes will be used to return the number of jurors.

createDispute(uint256,bytes).return: disputeID ID of the dispute created.

currentRuling(uint256).details: Return the current ruling of a dispute. This is useful for parties to know if they should appeal.
currentRuling(uint256).return: ruling The current ruling which will be given if there is no appeal. If it is not available, return 0.

disputeStatus(uint256).details: Return the status of a dispute.

params._disputeID: ID of the dispute to rule.

disputeStatus(uint256).return: status The status of the dispute.

executeOrder(bytes32,uint256,address).details: General call function where the contract execute an arbitrary call with data and ETH following governor orders.

executeRuling(uint256).details: Execute the ruling of a dispute which is in the state executable. UNTRUSTED.

params.disputeID: ID of the dispute to execute the ruling.

params._juror: The juror we want to get the last session he voted.

getLastSessionVote(uint256,address).return: lastSessionVote The last session the juror voted.

getStakePerDraw().details: Compute the minimum activated pinakions in alpha. Note there may be multiple draws for a single user on a single dispute.

params._appeals: Which appeal (or 0 for the initial session).
params._voteID: The ID of the vote for this appeal (or initial session).

getVoteAccount(uint256,uint256,uint256).return: account The address of the voter.

params._appeals: Which appeal (or 0 for the initial session).

getVoteCount(uint256,uint256,uint256).return: voteCount The amount of votes the winning choice (or those who are tied) has.

params._appeals: Which appeal (or 0 for the initial session).
params._voteID: The ID of the vote for this appeal (or initial session).

getVoteRuling(uint256,uint256,uint256).return: ruling The ruling given by the voter.

params._appeals: Which appeal (or 0 for the initial session).

getWinningChoice(uint256,uint256).return: winningChoice The currently winning choice (or 0 if it's tied). Note that 0 can also be return if the majority refuses to arbitrate.

params._appeals: Which appeal (or 0 for the initial session).

getWinningCount(uint256,uint256).return: winningCount The amount of votes the winning choice (or those who are tied) has.

isDrawn(uint256,address,uint256).details: Is the juror drawn in the draw of the dispute.

params._draw: The draw. Note that it starts at 1.

isDrawn(uint256,address,uint256).return: drawn True if the juror is drawn, false otherwise.

multipleShotTokenRepartition(uint256,uin.details: Execute token repartition on a dispute for a specific number of votes. This should only be called if oneShotTokenRepartition will throw because there are too many votes (will use too much gas). Note that There are 3 iterations per vote. e.g. A dispute with 1 appeal (2 sessions) and 3 votes per session will have 18 iterations

params._maxIterations: the maxium number of votes to repartition in this iteration

oneShotTokenRepartition(uint256).details: Execute all the token repartition. Note that this function could consume to much gas if there is too much votes.  It is O(v), where v is the number of votes for this dispute. In the next version, there will also be a function to execute it in multiple calls  (but note that one shot execution, if possible, is less expensive).

passPeriod().details: To call to go to a new period. TRUSTED.

penalizeInactiveJuror(address,uint256,ui.details: Steal part of the tokens and the arbitration fee of a juror who failed to vote. Note that a juror who voted but without all his weight can't be penalized. It is possible to not penalize with the maximum weight. But note that it can lead to arbitration fees being kept by the contract and never distributed.

params._disputeID: The ID of the dispute the juror was drawn.
params._draws: The list of draws the juror was drawn. Numbering starts at 1 and the numbers should be increasing.
params._jurorAddress: Address of the juror to steal tokens from.

receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,.details: Callback of approveAndCall - transfer pinakions of a juror in the contract. Should be called by the pinakion contract. TRUSTED.

params._amount: Amount of tokens to transfer to Kleros (in basic units).

params._arbitrationFeePerJuror: The fee which will be paid to each juror.

params._defaultNumberJuror: Number of drawn jurors unless specified otherwise.

params._maxAppeals: Number of times a dispute can be appealed. When exceeded appeal cost becomes NON_PAYABLE_AMOUNT.

params._minActivatedToken: Minimum of tokens to be activated (in basic units).

params._timePerPeriod: The minimum time each period lasts (seconds).

validDraws(address,uint256,uint256[]).details: Must be used to verify that a juror has been draw at least _draws.length times. We have to require the user to specify the draws that lead the juror to be drawn. Because doing otherwise (looping through all draws) could consume too much gas.

params._disputeID: The ID of the dispute the juror was drawn.
params._draws: The list of draws the juror was drawn. It draw numbering starts at 1 and the numbers should be increasing. Note that in most cases this list will just contain 1 number.
params._jurorAddress: Address of the juror we want to verify draws.
params.valid: true if the draws are valid.

voteRuling(uint256,uint256,uint256[]).details: Vote a ruling. Juror must input the draw ID he was drawn. Note that the complexity is O(d), where d is amount of times the juror was drawn. Since being drawn multiple time is a rare occurrence and that a juror can always vote with less weight than it has, it is not a problem. But note that it can lead to arbitration fees being kept by the contract and never distributed.

params._disputeID: The ID of the dispute the juror was drawn.
params._draws: The list of draws the juror was drawn. Draw numbering starts at 1 and the numbers should be increasing.

withdraw(uint256).details: Withdraw tokens. Note that we can't withdraw the tokens which are still atStake.  Jurors can't withdraw their tokens if they have deposited some during this session. This is to prevent jurors from withdrawing tokens they could loose.
